metaDescription: D'Angelo & Sons Roofing won Brampton's 2026 award. Family-owned since 1978, covering shingle, metal, flat and emergency roof repair across Peel Region.
summary: D'Angelo & Sons Roofing & Exteriors is a family-owned roofing contractor serving Brampton and the Greater Toronto Area, operating since 1978. The company covers residential and commercial roof installation, replacement and repair across shingle, metal and flat roofing systems.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: D'Angelo & Sons handles roof installation, replacement and repair for both residential and commercial properties, working across shingle, metal and flat roofing systems rather than a single roof type. Emergency roof repair is also listed among its services, meaning the company takes on urgent leak or storm-damage calls, not only scheduled replacements. Being family-owned since 1978 gives the company a longer operating history than many roofing contractors in the region.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: Covering shingle, metal and flat roofing means the company can serve a wide range of home styles and roof profiles, including flat commercial roofs that require different materials and detailing than a typical residential shingle roof. The inclusion of emergency repair suggests the company fields time-sensitive calls outside a normal scheduled quote process. Homeowners should confirm directly how quickly the company can respond to an active leak versus a planned replacement.

editorial.heading: What to Expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews were available for this listing at the time of research. This is a short, third-party award listing based on limited public information, so homeowners should ask directly for licensing details, manufacturer certifications and recent local references before booking.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: D'Angelo & Sons is based in Brampton and serves Brampton and the wider Greater Toronto Area. Homeowners outside that footprint should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means D'Angelo & Sons Roofing & Exteriors was selected as the top business in the Roofing Replacement & Repair category for Brampton through an independent editorial review of public information. No business pays a fee to be selected, and this listing is based on limited publicly available detail.
